learn.hook: Railway tickets say 14:30, not 2:30 p.m. Why? Because trains run day and night!
points: Read a clock: the short hand shows the hour, the long hand the minutes (each number = 5 minutes).
a.m. is from midnight to noon; p.m. is from noon to midnight.
24-hour time counts hours from 0 to 23. Morning times stay the same: 9:15 a.m. = 09:15.
For p.m. times after 12 noon, add 12 to the hour: 2:30 p.m. = 14:30, 11:45 p.m. = 23:45.
12 noon = 12:00 and 12 midnight = 00:00. To go back, subtract 12 from hours bigger than 12: 18:20 = 6:20 p.m.
learn.reallife: Trains, flights and bus tickets in India use 24-hour time so no one mixes up morning and evening.

quiz.q: The short hand is just past 8 and the long hand points to 3. What time is it?
quiz.explain: Short hand → 8 o'clock. Long hand on 3 → 3 × 5 = 15 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Swaps the hour and minute hands

quiz.q: Yoga starts when the clock shows 6:30. The long hand points to which number?
quiz.explain: 30 minutes is 6 × 5 minutes, so the long hand is on 6.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the long hand points to 30

quiz.q: Write 2:30 p.m. in 24-hour time.
Write 9:15 a.m. in 24-hour time.
quiz.explain: Morning times keep the same hour: 09:15.

quiz.q: A train leaves at 18:20. What is that in 12-hour time?
quiz.explain: 18 − 12 = 6, and it is after noon: 6:20 p.m.

quiz.q: What is 12 midnight in 24-hour time?
quiz.explain: Midnight starts a new day at 00:00. 12:00 is noon.

quiz.q: A flight lands at 23:45. When is that?
Which time is the latest in the day?
quiz.explain: 21:10 is 9:10 p.m., the latest of these.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 09:50 is late because of the 9

teach.ask: Gappu's bus ticket says 16:45. What time is that on my clock with a.m. and p.m.?
teach.nudge: What do I do with hours bigger than 12?

learn.hook: Your train leaves at 9:40 a.m. and reaches at 11:15 a.m. How long will you be looking out of the window?
points: Duration means how long something takes, from the start time to the end time.
Count on from the start: first to the next full hour, then whole hours, then the extra minutes.
a.m. is from midnight to noon. p.m. is from noon to midnight.
To find an end time, add the duration to the start time. 60 minutes make 1 hour.

example.q: A train leaves at 9:40 a.m. and arrives at 11:15 a.m. How long is the journey?

learn.reallife: Train timetables, school periods and TV shows all have start times, end times and durations.

games.title: Kabir's day
games.prompt: Put Kabir's day in order of time

items.text: From 3:00 p.m. to 3:45 p.m. is ___ minutes
From 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. is ___ hours
Half an hour after 4:45 p.m. is ___

quiz.q: A cricket match starts at 2:00 p.m. and ends at 5:30 p.m. How long does it last?
quiz.explain: 2:00 to 5:00 is 3 hours. 5:00 to 5:30 is 30 minutes more.

quiz.q: A film starts at 6:15 p.m. and lasts 2 hours 20 minutes. When does it end?
School runs from 8:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. How long is the school day?
quiz.explain: 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon is 4 hours. Noon to 1:30 p.m. is 1 hour 30 minutes. Total 5 hours 30 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Does 8 − 1 and gets confused crossing noon

quiz.q: Meena starts her homework at 4:50 p.m. and finishes at 5:25 p.m. How many minutes does she take?
quiz.explain: 4:50 to 5:00 is 10 minutes. 5:00 to 5:25 is 25 minutes. 10 + 25 = 35.
quiz.mistake: Subtracts 50 − 25 or treats an hour as 100 minutes

quiz.q: Kabir's train leaves at 10:45 a.m. The journey takes 50 minutes. When does it arrive?
Joseph sleeps from 9:30 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. How long does he sleep?
quiz.explain: 9:30 p.m. to midnight is 2 hours 30 minutes. Midnight to 6:00 a.m. is 6 hours. Total 8 hours 30 minutes.

quiz.q: A bus ride takes 1 hour 15 minutes. How many minutes is that?
Aisha practises the flute for 25 minutes every day for 4 days. How long does she practise in all?
quiz.mistake: Changes 100 minutes into 1 hour 0 minutes, as if an hour were 100 minutes

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'My nap starts at 1:40 and ends at 2:15. How do I find how long I slept?'
teach.praise: Yawn! 1:40 to 2:00 is 20 minutes, then 15 more. 35 minutes of sleep!
teach.nudge: Where do I start counting? Is it easier to go to the next full hour first?

learn.hook: Ready, steady, go! In a race, the smallest time wins. Let's read stopwatches like a sports judge!
points: In a race, the runner who takes the least time is the fastest.
To compare times, write them in the same unit, usually seconds.
1 minute 5 seconds = 65 seconds, which is more than 58 seconds.
The difference between two times tells how much faster one runner is.

example.q: Riya ran in 52 seconds, Aisha in 1 minute 3 seconds and Harpreet in 49 seconds. Who won? Put them in order.
example.answer: Harpreet won; then Riya, then Aisha

learn.reallife: Sports days, the Olympics and car races measure winners in seconds and even parts of a second.

games.title: How long does it take?
items: a train ride from Delhi to Mumbai

games.title: True or false?
items: In a race, the runner with the least time wins.
A blink of an eye takes about 1 hour.
A blink takes much less than a second.

quiz.q: In a 50 m race, Arjun took 14 seconds, Kabir 12 seconds and Joseph 15 seconds. Who won?
quiz.explain: The smallest time wins. Kabir took only 12 seconds.

quiz.q: In that race, Kabir took 12 seconds and Joseph took 15 seconds. How many seconds faster was Kabir?
quiz.mistake: Adds the times instead of finding the difference

quiz.q: Which is less time: 1 minute 5 seconds or 58 seconds?
quiz.explain: 1 minute 5 seconds = 65 seconds. 58 is less than 65.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 58 is more because 58 is bigger than 5

quiz.q: Four relay runners took 15, 14, 16 and 15 seconds. What was the team's total time?
A stopwatch shows 1 minute 20 seconds. How many seconds is that?
quiz.mistake: Writes 1 and 20 side by side as 120

quiz.q: Meena ran the race in 58 seconds last week and 51 seconds today. By how many seconds did she improve?
quiz.explain: 58 − 51 = 7 seconds less, so she is 7 seconds faster.

quiz.q: Riya ran in 50 seconds, Arjun in 47 seconds and Aisha in 53 seconds. Who came second?
quiz.explain: Order of times: 47 (Arjun), 50 (Riya), 53 (Aisha). Riya is second.

quiz.q: Harpreet's heart beats about 80 times in a minute. About how many times does it beat in 30 seconds?
quiz.explain: 30 seconds is half a minute. Half of 80 is 40.

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How do I know who is the fastest in a race?'
teach.praise: Zoom! The one who takes the least time wins. I'm racing the sparrows now!
teach.nudge: Does the fastest runner take more time or less time? How do I compare 1 minute 5 seconds and 58 seconds?

topics.title: How much can you do in a minute?

learn.hook: How many times can you clap in one minute? Guess first, then time it!
points: Some events take only a few seconds: a blink, a sneeze, a clap, writing your name.
First estimate how many times you can do an action in a minute, then time it to check.
If you skip 12 times in 10 seconds, in 1 minute (60 s) you could skip about 6 × 12 = 72 times.
Use a stopwatch or the seconds hand to time short activities like running 100 m or writing a word.

example.q: Neha writes her name 4 times in 20 seconds. About how many times can she write it in 1 minute?

learn.reallife: Coaches time sprints in seconds, and typing tests count words per minute.

quiz.q: Which of these takes only a few seconds?
quiz.explain: A blink is over in less than a second.
quiz.mistake: Picks an activity that takes minutes or hours

quiz.q: Sunil skips 12 times in 10 seconds. About how many skips in 1 minute?
Neha writes her name 4 times in 20 seconds. About how many times in 1 minute?
Ria guesses she can clap 50 times in a minute. She times it and claps 85 times. What should she do next time?
quiz.explain: Checking helps improve estimates: her real number was more than her guess.
quiz.mistake: Does not use the check to improve

quiz.q: Which tool is best for timing a 100 m race?
quiz.mistake: Picks a tool that does not measure time

quiz.q: Arjun runs 100 m in 18 seconds. Kiran takes 21 seconds. How much faster is Arjun?
Which is the best unit to time writing one short word?
quiz.explain: Writing a word takes only a few seconds.
quiz.mistake: Chooses a unit that is too big

quiz.q: Meena hops 15 times in 15 seconds. At the same speed, how many hops in 1 minute?
quiz.explain: 1 hop each second: 60 hops in 60 seconds.

teach.ask: Gappu flaps his wings 9 times in 10 seconds. About how many flaps in a minute?
teach.praise: A minute is 6 lots of 10 seconds, so 6 × 9 = 54 flaps!
teach.nudge: How many 10-second parts are in one minute?

learn.hook: The thin, fast hand on a clock races round in exactly one minute. Let us read it!
points: The seconds hand makes one full turn in 60 seconds.
Each number on the clock stands for 5 seconds on the seconds hand: at 3 it shows 15 seconds, at 6 it shows 30.
To read how long something took, start with the seconds hand at 12 and see where it stops.
To draw the seconds hand for 40 seconds, point it at 8 (40 ÷ 5 = 8).
If it stops between numbers, count the small marks: each small mark is 1 second.

example.q: A race starts with the seconds hand at 12. It ends with the hand at 9. How long did the race take (less than a minute)?

learn.reallife: Doctors use the seconds hand to count heartbeats, and teachers use it in timed tests.

items.text: Hand at 12 after one full turn → ___ seconds

quiz.q: How long does the seconds hand take to make one full turn?
quiz.explain: One full turn of the seconds hand is 1 minute = 60 seconds.
quiz.mistake: Thinks it moves like the hour hand

quiz.q: The seconds hand starts at 12 and stops at 4. How many seconds have passed?
Starting at 12, the seconds hand stops at 11. How many seconds?
Where should you draw the seconds hand to show 35 seconds?
Where does the seconds hand point after 45 seconds, if it started at 12?
The seconds hand starts at 3 and stops at 8. How many seconds passed?
The seconds hand stops 2 small marks after 6. How many seconds is that from 12?
quiz.explain: At 6 it is 30 seconds; 2 more small marks add 2 seconds: 32.

quiz.q: The seconds hand goes round once and then on to 3. How many seconds in all?
quiz.explain: One full turn = 60 s, then 15 s more: 75 seconds.

teach.ask: Gappu timed his flight with the seconds hand. It started at 12 and stopped at 10. How long did I fly?
teach.praise: Each number is 5 seconds, so 10 × 5 = 50 seconds!
teach.nudge: How many seconds does each number on the clock stand for?

learn.hook: Clap once. That took about one second! How many claps fit in a minute?
points: A second is a very short time, about one clap.
60 seconds = 1 minute and 60 minutes = 1 hour.
Minutes to seconds: multiply by 60. 3 minutes = 3 × 60 = 180 seconds.
Seconds to minutes: divide by 60. 240 seconds = 4 minutes.
Mixed times: 2 minutes 15 seconds = 120 + 15 = 135 seconds.
learn.reallife: Races, cooking timers, cricket over timings and video clips use seconds and minutes.

quiz.q: How many seconds make 1 minute?
quiz.mistake: Thinks time works in hundreds like money

quiz.q: How many seconds are there in 3 minutes?
quiz.mistake: Adds 60 + 3, or uses 100 seconds in a minute

quiz.q: Write 2 minutes 15 seconds in seconds.
quiz.mistake: Writes the numbers side by side (215)

quiz.q: 240 seconds is how many minutes?
Which of these takes about one second?
quiz.explain: A single clap is very quick, about one second.
quiz.mistake: Has no feel for how short a second is

quiz.q: How many seconds are there in 1 hour?
quiz.explain: 1 hour = 60 minutes, and each minute is 60 seconds. 60 × 60 = 3,600.

quiz.q: 90 seconds is the same as…
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 minute is 100 seconds or 40 seconds

quiz.q: Riya held her breath for 45 seconds. Arjun held his for 1 minute. How many seconds longer was Arjun?
quiz.mistake: Takes 1 minute as 100 seconds, or adds

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How do I change minutes into seconds?'
teach.praise: Tick tock! Each minute has 60 seconds, so I multiply by 60!
teach.nudge: How many seconds are in one minute? What do I do with that number?

topics.title: Hours to minutes with double number lines

learn.hook: A train journey takes 4 hours. How many minutes is that? Multiply by 60!
points: 1 hour = 60 minutes. To change hours to minutes, multiply by 60: 4 hours = 240 minutes.
A double number line shows hours on top and minutes below: 1 ↔ 60, 2 ↔ 120, 3 ↔ 180.
Halfway between 1 and 2 hours is 1 hour 30 minutes = 90 minutes.
The same works for minutes and seconds: 1 ↔ 60, 2 ↔ 120 …
To go from minutes to hours, divide by 60: 300 minutes = 5 hours.

example.q: Use a double number line to change 3 1/2 hours into minutes.

learn.reallife: Cooking times, bus journeys and cricket matches are planned in hours and minutes.

quiz.q: How many minutes are in 4 hours?
On a double number line, which minute value lines up with 3 hours?
What sits halfway between 1 hour and 2 hours, in minutes?
A bus journey takes 300 minutes. How many hours is that?
How many minutes are in 2 1/2 hours?
quiz.explain: 2 hours = 120 minutes, half an hour = 30 minutes. 120 + 30 = 150.

quiz.q: A film lasts 135 minutes. How long is that in hours and minutes?
quiz.explain: 120 minutes = 2 hours, and 15 minutes are left.

quiz.q: On a double number line for minutes and seconds, which second value lines up with 5 minutes?
A cricket match lasts 7 hours. How many minutes is that?

teach.ask: Gappu's journey takes 3 hours 20 minutes. How many minutes is that in all?
teach.nudge: How many minutes are in one hour?

topics.title: Working backwards to find start times

learn.hook: The film ends at 9:10 p.m. and lasts 2 hours 25 minutes. When did it start? Let us go backwards in time!
points: End time = start time + duration. Start time = end time − duration.
To work backwards, first take away the hours, then the minutes.
From 9:10 p.m., go back 2 hours to 7:10 p.m., then 25 minutes more to 6:45 p.m.
If the minutes go below 0, borrow an hour: 60 minutes.
Check: add the duration to your start time and see if you get the end time.

example.q: A train reaches at 11:20 a.m. after a journey of 3 hours 40 minutes. When did it start?

learn.reallife: When you must reach school by 8:00 a.m. and the ride is 35 minutes, you work out when to leave home.

games.title: Work back from 9:10 p.m. by 2 h 25 min
items: Start at the end time 9:10 p.m.

quiz.q: A film ends at 9:10 p.m. It lasts 2 hours 25 minutes. When did it start?
quiz.mistake: Adds the duration instead of subtracting

quiz.q: Riya must reach school at 8:00 a.m. The bus takes 35 minutes. When must she catch the bus?
A train reaches at 11:20 a.m. after 3 hours 40 minutes. When did it leave?
A puja ended at 12:30 p.m. after 1 hour 45 minutes. When did it begin?
quiz.mistake: Gets the minutes wrong when borrowing an hour

quiz.q: Cooking takes 50 minutes and the food must be ready at 1:15 p.m. When should cooking start?
quiz.explain: 1:15 − 15 minutes = 1:00. Then 35 more minutes back: 12:25 p.m.

quiz.q: A match started at 3:40 p.m. and lasted 1 hour 35 minutes. When did it end?
quiz.mistake: Writes 75 minutes instead of changing to an hour

quiz.q: A night bus arrives at 6:00 a.m. after 8 hours 30 minutes. When did it leave?
quiz.explain: 6:00 a.m. − 8 hours = 10:00 p.m. (the night before). Then − 30 minutes = 9:30 p.m.

quiz.q: How can you check a start time you worked out backwards?
options: Add the start and end times
Add the duration to it and see if you get the end time
quiz.explain: Adding the duration to the start should give the end time.

teach.ask: Gappu's show ends at 4:00 p.m. and lasts 1 hour 20 minutes. When does it start?
teach.praise: 4:00 − 1 hour = 3:00, then 20 minutes back is 2:40 p.m.!
teach.nudge: Should I add or take away the duration from the end time?
